licenses: CC BY-NC 4.0 for the released dataset
detector_provenance: Publisher-released FCOS person detections, trained on CrowdHuman train and validation.
timebase: Both MOT files are one-based over manually annotated keyframes at nominal 5 Hz. keyframe_source_frames gives exact one-based raw video frame alignment.
box_format: Native source pixel xywh coordinates, unchanged.
annotation_rules: Normal/standing/sitting people are class 1, labelled distractors class 8, and crowds class 13.
source_id_scope: Known remappings from publisher download script; other released assets have distinct IDs but original recording and site independence is unverified.
split_rule: Known external-access assets are exploratory. Other official test assets are test; the remaining official train assets are development when the first 32 SHA-256 bits of source_id are divisible by five, and calibration otherwise.
